title: Learn to Play Mah-Jongg
description: 10:00 AM – 12:00 PM · Discover the fascinating world of Mah-jongg! Join us for a beginner-friendly session where you'll learn the basics of this classic tile-based game. Jill Wilson, our experienced instructor, will guide you through game setup, basic rules, and essential strategies. Registration is required as space is limited to 8 students.

title: Mahjongg for Independent Players
description: 1:00 PM – 3:00 PM · Looking to enjoy an afternoon of friendly games of mah-jongg for independent players? Join us at the Library every Wednesday from 1-3pm. Bring your 2026 card if you have one, although we have plenty of loaners if you don't! We'll have tables, cloths, chairs, and sets.   NOTE: This is not a mah-jongg lesson. A general knowledge of the game is necessary to join. Please register in advance if you'd like to join so we can make sure we have enough tables set up for everyone!

title: Kids Cook
description: 3:30 PM – 4:30 PM · Join us every Wednesday for a fun and tasty adventure in the kitchen! Learn how to make delicious and creative snacks using safe cooking tools alongside other young chefs. Free and open to kids ages 5-12.  Ünete a nosotros todos los miércoles para una divertida y sabrosa aventura en la cocina. Aprende a hacer bocadillos deliciosos y creativos usando herramientas de cocina seguras junto a otros jóvenes chefs. Gratis y abierto para niños de 5 a 12 años.

title: The Classics Taproom Society: Foundation with Laura Colbert
description: 5:30 PM – 7:00 PM · The Classics Taproom Society: Old Books. Fresh Pours. New Conversations. Discover the magic of classic literature in our newest book club, where we celebrate the milestones of timeless works! With the upcoming 50th, 75th, and 100th anniversaries of these literary treasures in 2026 and 2027, there's no better time to dive deep into great stories. Each month features a passionate guest moderator who will guide you through rich discussions. The library will provide light appetizers and Telluride Brewing Company will also be offering $5 TBC beers during the book club. …
